policy: All hypotheses and controls frozen before outcomes. First year is descriptive; final two years are held-out relative to this frozen screen, NOT globally untouched data. No optimisation or candidate selection.

rules.reference: Last completed broker-UTC D1 range for gold/US100; last completed Monday-UTC W1 range for BTC. Frozen until next reference period.
rules.rejection: Bullish close inside lower eighth after touching its boundary: long to midpoint, stop below min(previous range low, signal low)-0.1 ATR. Mirror shorts in upper eighth. Quartile control changes only fraction from 1/8 to 1/4.
rules.range_breakout: Completed close crosses prior range high/low; require a later directional candle to retest boundary within eight signal bars and close outside. Stop beyond boundary/retest wick by 0.25 ATR; target 2R.
rules.fan: Confirmed H4 body-independent high/low pivots: strict two completed neighbours on each side. Ascending fan from a higher low, descending from lower high. Slope frozen from price change between latest two confirmed same-type pivots divided by their tradable H4-bar separation (at least four). One 1x1 slope tested, maximum age 32 H4 bars; completed break followed by retest within eight signal bars. Stop wick/line +0.25 ATR; target 2R.
rules.cycles: H1 EMA12/26 crossover; stop 1.5 ATR14, target 2R. Gate permits signals at H1 trading-bar ages 8/16/32 +/-1 after latest H4 pivot CONFIRMATION, not its hindsight timestamp. New pivot replaces clock. Baseline has no gate.
rules.random_control: Seed 26100950 and pivot confirmation timestamp generate three separated centres in 2..32, +/-1-bar windows: same nine of 33 eligible ages as cycle gate. Fixed before outcomes; one native placebo, not proof from a single random comparison.
rules.execution: Next tick after completed signal; at most one successful trade per UTC day and one position per independent account. No additional session/news/ADX/DI filters; BTC weekends included. Entry through 20:30 UTC, close at first tick >=20:55 UTC or after eight hours. No trailing/partials.
rules.risk: 0.5% current closed balance; volume floored to broker step. Skip below-minimum lots, invalid price geometry or insufficient margin. Cash risk is nominal, not guaranteed maximum loss.

limitations: These are declared Gann-inspired mechanical adaptations, not an exact historical Gann system or evidence of predictive geometry.
Broker pre-2026 ticks may be generated from M1 history. Fresh 2026 quality checked separately.
Seven hypotheses per asset create selection risk. Show all outcomes; no best-set selection on validation.
Daily/session stops and retest/ATR/EMA thresholds are research assumptions. First screening is not a full optimized pipeline.
